key.description: The public key, as a P-256 did:key.

createdAt.description: When the runner published this key.

main.description: Kept in the runner's account. An owner seals each secret it gives the runner to this key, with HPKE (RFC 9180) in base mode: DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256 and AES-128-GCM, so only the runner, which keeps the private half, can open it. The runner writes it again when its key changes; a value sealed to an older key names that key.

description: The key a knotless runner opens the secrets owners give it with.
